summary: Master Strategic Cost and Value Management in Procurement. Join our course to learn techniques that boost efficiency and maximize value in purchasing processes.
lede: Strategic Cost and Value Management in Procurement helps you move beyond unit-price comparisons by assessing total cost, lifecycle impact, supplier risk, and contract performance. You will use spend analysis, Total Cost of Ownership modelling, cost-driver mapping, supplier cost breakdowns, and value-for-money analysis to build stronger sourcing decisions. The course turns procurement knowledge into a structured approach for managing cost, supplier performance, and measurable business value. Through practical exercises based on category decisions, contract trade-offs, incomplete data, and reporting needs, you will develop credible business cases, track procurement KPIs, and support savings, risk reduction, and supplier value creation.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who handle procurement cost, supplier value, and sourcing decisions in day-to-day operations and leadership reporting.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of procurement or supply chain operations; basic understanding of supplier contracts and spend categories; comfort reading simple cost summaries and spreadsheets. No programming is required, but you should be able to work with Excel-style cost models, procurement dashboards, and category data. Advanced analytics topics are taught at an operational application level, not engineering depth.
